query: Spain LOIA AI governance bill Proyecto de Ley Orgánica buen uso gobernanza inteligencia artificial expediente 121/000096 enmienda a la totalidad status BOCG July 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on Spain's LOIA AI governance bill (expediente 121/000096):

**Bill status as of July 2026:**
- **Current stage**: "Enmiendas" (amendments) phase within the Comisión de Economía, Comercio y Transformación Digital, under ordinary procedure
- **Published in BOCG**: Serie A, núm. A-97-1, on 12 June 2026 (this is the only BOCG document to date)

**On the enmienda a la totalidad specifically:**
- **No enmienda a la totalidad has been published in the BOCG** as of mid-July 2026. No subsequent BOCG documents (A-97-2, A-97-3) exist yet — which is where amendments/totalidad motions are typically published.
- The **amendment deadline was extended** from 30 June 2026 to **2 September 2026** ("ampliación de enmiendas"). This means the amendment window remained open through the summer, so any enmienda a la totalidad would only be consolidated and published after that deadline.

**Key chronology (2026):**
- 26 May — Consejo de Ministros approved and remitted to Congreso
- 28 May — Presented
- 8 June — Qualified by the Mesa
- 12 June — Published in BOCG (A-97-1)

**Important caveats:** The bill is not yet in force and not applicable law — it still must complete committee, Pleno, and Senate stages. It adapts EU Regulation 2024/1689 (AI Act), designating AESIA/AEPD/CGPJ as authorities, with sanctions, sandboxes, a public-sector AI inventory, and a whistleblower complaints channel.

The full report and structured data (key facts, sources with access dates, and dated data points) have been delivered.

key_facts: Expediente 121/000096 (XV Legislatura): Proyecto de Ley Orgánica para el buen uso y la gobernanza de la inteligencia artificial — Spain's national AI governance bill adapting EU Regulation 2024/1689 (AI Act).
Approved by Consejo de Ministros on 26 May 2026; presented in Congreso 28 May 2026; qualified 8 June 2026; published in BOCG Serie A núm. A-97-1 on 12 June 2026.
Current status (official Congreso page, updated 12/06/2026): 'Enmiendas' phase in the Comisión de Economía, Comercio y Transformación Digital; ordinary ('Normal') procedure.
Amendment deadline originally 30/06/2026 (18:00), EXTENDED to 02/09/2026 (18:00) via 'Ampliación de enmiendas.'
As of mid-July 2026, NO enmienda a la totalidad has been published in the BOCG; the only BOCG document is A-97-1 (initiative text). No A-97-2/A-97-3 found.
Trackers confirm no debates, amendments, committee reports, or votes registered beyond initial publication.

Bill designates AESIA, AEPD and CGPJ as notification/surveillance authorities; sets infractions and proportional sanctions; creates sandboxes; mandates public-sector AI inventory and transparency; creates single complaints window with whistleblower protection; amends tax, social-security and electoral rules.
The bill is NOT yet in force / NOT applicable law; still requires committee, Pleno and Senate stages.
The EU AI Act provisions it complements become applicable from 2 August 2026, independently of the Spanish bill's status.
